facts.fact: KRAY 对 KANDINSKY 说距会面窗口开启还有一分钟、马上就到时间，KANDINSKY 提醒他若不确定可以爽约不来。
facts.anchor: One minute to the start of the window for the meeting,” said KRAY. “Almost go time.”

facts.fact: KRAY 说 EVERSHAG 做对了，他欠 Marla、Tom、Mahbod 以及所有其他人的。
facts.anchor: EVERSHAG got it right,” he said. “I owe this to Marla. And Tom. And Mahbod. And all the others.

facts.fact: 两人在沉默中坐了半分钟，随后 KANDINSKY 说 KRAY 了不起并说爱他，KRAY 回答也爱她，爱到觉得她可能偷走了他的心。
facts.anchor:
They sat there for half a minute in silence.

“You’re amazing,” KANDINSKY said finally. “I love you.”

“I love you back,” said KRAY. “So much so that I’m beginning to think you may have stolen my heart.”

facts.fact: KRAY 把信封推给 Cooper，说这能证明 GOOWIKI 是骗局、Wacker 一直在对国会撒谎，并说 Wacker 的人力资源主管 Evita P. EVERSHAG 主动提供了它，她比所有人都勇敢、需要保护她。
facts.anchor: This is what you need to prove that GOOWIKI is a sham and that Wacker has been lying to Congress. Wacker’s HR Chief, Evita P. EVERSHAG, reached out with it. She’s braver than any of us — we need to protect her.

facts.fact: KRAY 用他和 Cooper 为紧急联络事先设定的协议触发了这次会面，Cooper 完全按协议行事。
facts.anchor: KRAY had triggered the meeting using the protocol he and Cooper had set up in case of an emergency need to communicate. Cooper had followed the protocol to a T.

facts.fact: KRAY 告诉 Cooper 文件标着 TOP SECRET，让他到自己的 SCIF 里再打开。
facts.anchor: It’s marked TOP SECRET — open it in your SCIF.

facts.fact: KRAY 说他们打算把 GOOWIKI 的钱停在基础经费里保住饭碗，再转拨给他们称为‘Operation Kitchen Appliance’的项目——一个国会未批准的活动。
facts.anchor: Park it in base funds to protect their rice bowl,” said KRAY, “then reallocate it to something they’re calling ‘Operation Kitchen Appliance,’ an activity not approved by Congress.

facts.fact: 回 Jeep 的路上，KRAY 提醒自己要把 EVERSHAG 的银色开信刀还回去。
facts.anchor: On his way back to the Jeep, KRAY reminded himself he needed to return EVERSHAG’s silver letter opener.
